additions.label: Abracadabra MIMSwap unadjusted token liquidity addition
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI evidence only; not live runtime identity, authorization, balances, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses, canonical calldata and value controls remain mandatory.

Exact nonproxy Ethereum Router 0x7202b7ca846fc93467e95fa279bc6085f2d5b6fe. Router.sol addLiquidityUnsafe enforces ensureDeadline(deadline) and immutable factory onlyKnownPool(lp). It transfers both named token amounts from msg.sender directly into that known pool using existing allowances, then buyShares(to) and minimumShares; no arbitrary payload or authority management.

Amounts are raw underlying token units; minimumShares is LP-share units. Unlike adjusted addLiquidity, all requested inputs are transferred without reserve-ratio adjustment or refund. Excess/imbalanced inputs may economically donate value to the pool, and minimumShares does not bound that donation. Caller-selected recipient can differ from payer. Fees, pricing, factory membership and pool behavior remain dependencies. Nonpayable; zero native value.

additions.label: Abracadabra MIMSwap unadjusted ETH liquidity addition
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI evidence only; not live runtime identity, authorization, balances, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses, canonical calldata and value controls remain mandatory.

Router.sol addLiquidityETHUnsafe enforces deadline, onlyKnownPool(lp), and one pool side equal to immutable WETH; it wraps all msg.value, transfers WETH and caller-funded other token into that known pool, then buyShares(to) and minimumShares. No arbitrary payload or authority management.

msg.value is the complete ETH input in wei, tokenInAmount is raw other-token units, and minimumShares is LP-share units. additions.label: Lorenzo sUSD1+ direct funded share supply
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI evidence only; not live runtime identity, authorization, balances, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses, canonical calldata and value controls remain mandatory.

BNB Chain sUSD1+ proxy 0x4f2760b32720f013e900dc92f65480137391199b resolves in retained source-service evidence to exact-match implementation 0x972c27ee69b19d7648cef365700c22713a9a31fd. sUSD1PlusVault.supply invokes _supply: accepted underlying token only, caller transferFrom directly to first configured custody portfolio, decimal alignment, minDepositAmount and positive current unit NAV, then floor(alignedAmount*1e18/unitNav) shares minted only to msg.sender. It is a funded investment operation, not privileged unbacked mint or bare transfer.

Underlying is configured USD1; alternative accepted tokens are normalized by decimals, not market prices. Shares have 18 decimals. Existing ERC20 allowance is required; nonpayable and zero native value. There is no caller minimum shares or deadline. Custody portfolio, NAV, acceptance, manager upgrades and redemption liquidity remain mutable external dependencies.

Unlike retail deposit, this source method immediately mints shares and does not create pendingShares or require KYT confirmShare. supply/_supply omit whenNotPaused, notBlacklisted and lock guards; this is a material semantic difference, not KYC clearance or permission to evade any independent policy. Product/legal eligibility, sanctions, custody and source risks remain. This admission grants no role, signature, approval, transfer or management authority.

additions.label: Inverse Finance sDOLA fixed DOLA-for-DBR auction
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI evidence only; not live runtime identity, authorization, balances, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses, canonical calldata and value controls remain mandatory.

Exact nonproxy Ethereum sDola 0xb45ad160634c528cc3d2926d9807104fa3157305; source src/sDola.sol buyDBR is public user purchase, not governance or operator management. It claims fixed savings rewards internally, enforces nonzero recipient and the current xy=k invariant, pulls exactDolaIn from msg.sender using existing DOLA allowance, stakes it in fixed savings, books weekly revenue, then transfers exactly exactDbrOut DBR to to. No arbitrary target/calldata, new approval, permit or role is supplied.

Both DOLA input and DBR output are raw token units; amount parameters are exact, not slippage-min/max fields. The invariant is a lower-bound solvency check, not a maximum acceptable price: overpayment is possible and no deadline/refund protects delayed calls. Source explicitly warns NEVER to expose directly to a UI because delay is likely to cause loss and recommends a helper/custom contract for immediate execution. Admission is metadata, not recommendation or financial-safety assurance. Nonpayable; zero native value.

Auction K/reserves, reward availability, recipient validity and fixed-token/savings behavior can revert or alter economics. This does not admit helper/executor surfaces, protocol reapprove, governance, historical L2 tokens or retired CCIP lanes.

additions.label: Open Dollar create collateral SAFE for registered native proxy
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI evidence only; not live runtime identity, authorization, balances, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses, canonical calldata and value controls remain mandatory.

Arbitrum ODSafeManager 0x8646cbd915eaad1a4e2ba5e2b67acec4957d5f1a source openSAFE accepts collateral type and _usr, rejects zero _usr, deploys a fixed SAFEHandler(safeEngine), records the new financial position owned by _usr and invokes fixed Vault721.mint(_usr,id) plus updateNfvState. No arbitrary calldata/target, token allowance, existing delegation change or generic proxy execution is accepted.

_usr must already be a native registered ODProxy in Vault721._proxyRegistry or mint reverts V721: non-native proxy. NFT is minted to that registered proxy owner, not automatically msg.sender; callers can create a SAFE for an existing intended proxy without executing the proxy. This capability does not create/register an ODProxy, grant safeCan/allowSAFE rights, or make a new SAFE controllable by a direct EOA.

Collateral type is bytes32. Creation has no deposit/debt amount and does not itself fund the SAFE or borrow. SAFEHandler creation establishes the fixed protocol ledger relationship needed for the new position, not user-selected delegation authority. Subsequent adjustments need existing owner/authorization and protocol solvency. Nonpayable; zero native value. No complete direct-EOA workflow or eligibility is promised.

existingFunctionUpdates.label: Abracadabra addLiquidity caller-funded single-pool MIMSwap operation
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not live authorization, persistent runtime attestation, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory. Nonpayable calls require zero native value; payable ETH entrypoints use msg.value as the complete ETH input (wei), wrap WETH internally and enforce the stated deadline.

Only Ethereum nonproxy MIMSwap Router 0x7202b7ca846fc93467e95fa279bc6085f2d5b6fe is covered, with exact-match complete deployed source/ABI. Abracadabra is counted once, including its MIMSwap product; Cauldrons, Spell staking, other chains and bridge/signature/executor methods are not admitted.

All selected operations pull token or LP-share input only from msg.sender, or consume msg.value. Existing token allowance may be needed but no approval, permit or authorization is granted. Pool, output recipient and ETH-refund addresses are caller inputs; transfers can go to that recipient. Pool address is limited by immutable factory.poolExists in every selected method, not arbitrary executable calldata.

Each selected single-pool swap enforces caller minimum output and deadline. ETH-input/output variants require the configured pool side to be WETH and wrap/unwrap it; recipient ETH transfer may fail. Token amounts use underlying native decimals, shares use pool LP units; fees and PMM pricing depend on that factory-listed pool and market state.

Adjusted addLiquidity matches the current reserve ratio with floor arithmetic and only transfers adjusted token inputs; ETH version refunds unused ETH to refundTo. minimumShares limits issued LP. One-sided/imbalanced adds first swap caller-specified input portion then ratio-adjust, refund leftover base/quote to caller, and enforce minimumShares but no independent interim-swap minimum.

removeLiquidity pulls caller LP shares, burns them through sellShares with empty callback bytes and enforces both token minima plus the passed deadline in the pool. ETH removal unwraps only its WETH side. One-sided removal burns both sides then swaps the unwanted side within the same pool and enforces final minAmountOut; no callback or arbitrary external action input is exposed.

Factory membership and pool implementations/configuration may change; dependency liquidity and runtime identities are not attested here. Pool creation and multipool route functions are explicitly unselected. Unadjusted Unsafe adds are separate reviewed capabilities; they transfer all input without reserve-ratio adjustment or refund and can economically donate excess value despite minimumShares. In particular, the multipool helper checks intermediate pools but not its final pool, so this inventory does not expose its unconstrained last target.

existingFunctionUpdates.label: Inverse Finance sDOLA deposit
warnings: Ethereum mainnet sDOLA only. Official docs explicitly shut down sDOLA CCIP lanes in August 2026; historical L2 tokens and all bridge functions are outside this integration.

Underlying is DOLA (0x865377367054516e17014ccded1e7d814edc9ce4), not USDC. Deposits/mints transfer caller DOLA using allowance and stake it in the fixed savings contract; withdrawals/redeems unstake and return DOLA to the chosen receiver. Delegated exits require owner share allowance.

No caller-set minimum shares/maximum assets/deadline. ERC4626 rounding, weekly revenue vesting, DOLA depeg, smart-contract and fluctuating yield risks apply. totalAssets is capped at 10**32; withdrawing must leave at least 10**16 DOLA accounting units and 10**18 total shares. maxWithdraw/maxRedeem do not subtract these residual minima and are not an execution guarantee.

No user cooldown or separate reward claim. Yield comes from DBR auctions and vests over the following week; direct buyDBR is separately inventoried as an exact-input/exact-output auction purchase with a source-level warning about delay/overpayment risk; protocol allowance maintenance is not admitted. Source warns against treating sDOLA as a borrowable asset in systems sensitive to atomic value jumps.

Deployment/ABI/source matching evidence, not a fresh runtime/RPC identity, balance, liquidity or successful-execution guarantee. All admitted calls are nonpayable with zero native value. Independent authorization, token approvals, pause and signing controls remain required.

existingFunctionUpdates.label: Lorenzo Claim settled USD1 redemption
warnings: Static source/ABI metadata only, not assurance of current runtime identity, balances, liquidity, safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, pauses, canonical calldata and value controls remain required. Require zero native value for these BNB Chain ERC20 flows; deposit ABI is payable but native funding is not supported by the reviewed sUSD1+ override.

BNB Chain sUSD1+ proxy 0x4F2760B32720F013E900DC92F65480137391199b currently resolves through ERC1967/UUPS to sUSD1PlusVault implementation 0x972c27EE69B19D7648cef365700c22713A9a31fd. Implementation source-service runtime exact_match; proxy generic-bytecode source is match only with no creation match, not relabeled exact and not used as protocol implementation ABI. Manager can upgrade future behavior.

underlying is USD1 0x8d0D000Ee44948FC98c9B98A4FA4921476f08B0d, observed through proxy getter; selected financial amounts are token base units and shares have 18 decimals with Precision=1e18. Accepted alternative ERC20s are manager-configured and normalized only by decimal count, not price/swapping. Do not treat USDT/USDC equivalence, fee-on-transfer behavior or changing accept list as guaranteed.

deposit pulls underlyingToken from msg.sender using allowance to vault, first into vault then onward to first configured custody portfolio (Ceffu wallet in source comments). It DOES NOT immediately mint usable shares: floor(alignedAmount*1e18/currentUnitNav) is added to caller pendingShares for current settlement period. Administrator-authorized KYT confirmation is separate and requires an EIP712 signature. confirmShare/refundShare signatures are deliberately excluded; this catalog does not promise a complete pending-deposit confirmation/refund workflow or ability to access funds.

deposit is payable at ABI level but reviewed override uses IERC20 transfers even for NATIVE_TOKEN sentinel and never wraps BNB. Extra msg.value on an ERC20 deposit is not forwarded/refunded and can remain trapped. Use accepted real ERC20 addresses with exactly zero native value. No caller-selected recipient or arbitrary strategy/execution payload exists.

requestWithdraw uses caller own usable shares after frozen shares and already queued withdrawals; zero is rejected, configured minimum applies unless withdrawing entire usable balance. Repeated requests in the same settlement period merge under requestId=settlementPeriod; requestTimestamp is refreshed. Shares remain in wallet balance but cannot be spent while queued. No immediate payout, cancellation, caller-defined minimum output or deadline is supplied.

withdraw(requestId) requires requestId+1 < settlementPeriod and an unexecuted request belonging to msg.sender. It removes queued accounting, burns requested shares and transfers only configured underlying USD1 to msg.sender. NAV used is getUnitNav(requestId+1), i.e. periodUnitNav[requestId], and floor(shares*unitNav/1e18) applies. Two manager period advances are required, not an enforced wall-clock settlement deadline. Treasury must actually hold enough USD1; custodied funds are not pulled back automatically by this method.

Primary March 2026 redemption guide describes estimated 3-6 days, variable settlement NAV, and claim step; this timing is not guaranteed by contract and large requests/other conditions can extend it. Guide quotes 35% management/performance fees; selected source has no per-call fee parameter/deduction and relies on administered NAV/custody accounting. Fee basis/current prospectus must be checked rather than inferred from source.

Selected retail deposit/request/withdraw enforce pause, caller-blacklist and reentrancy checks; manager can set/reset NAV (including prior periods), accepted underlying, portfolios, minimums, freeze balances, blacklist users, set transferability, signers and upgrade implementation. Investor exposure includes offchain CeFi strategies, custody, CEX and law-enforcement restrictions, not isolated onchain asset backing or guaranteed recovery.

Current official product guide explicitly geo-restricts several jurisdictions including US, Canada, China and Netherlands and says list is nonexhaustive and mutable. KYT, app terms, sanctions and jurisdictional eligibility remain external restrictions. No exemption or eligibility clearance is implied. No raw arbitrary executor, management, signature approval, bridge or share burn is admitted. The separate supply capability immediately mints caller-funded NAV-priced shares and omits the retail pause/blacklist/lock/KYT-pending path; this difference supplies no legal eligibility or independent-policy exemption.

export const getTokenList = (network: GebDeployment): TokenList => {
    return tokens[network]
}

export const getAddressList = (network: GebDeployment): ContractList => {
    return addresses[network]
}

export const getTokenDetails = (network: GebDeployment, tokenSymbol: string): TokenData | null => {
    const tokenList = getTokenList(network)
    if (tokenSymbol in tokenList) {
        return tokenList[tokenSymbol]
    }
    return null
}

export const getSubgraph = (network: GebDeployment): string => {
    return subgraphs[network]
}
